subject.title: feat: fire session reset hooks for daily and idle resets

question: Should automatic daily and idle rollovers become new `command:*` hook actions, or should OpenClaw expose them through a lifecycle-specific hook contract?
rationale: The branch adds two public internal-hook actions whose automatic semantics differ from the documented user-command family, so choosing the long-term extension boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Use a lifecycle-specific contract
options.body: Add or bridge a documented rollover/reset lifecycle surface and keep `command:*` reserved for actual commands.

options.title: Accept command-family expansion
options.body: Explicitly document that automatic daily and idle rollovers are command actions and accept their delivery to existing generic command subscribers.

recommendation.title: Use a lifecycle-specific contract
recommendation.body: Add or bridge a documented rollover/reset lifecycle surface and keep `command:*` reserved for actual commands.
